methodology.order_vs_assignment: fixed-plan experiment uses ONE frozen per-task mapping fixed_action(tid)=tid%3 for every order; greedy assignment is searched separately per order

orders.formula: Kahn ready-queue ordered by ascending task id

orders.name: stable_topo

orders.label: standard HEFT upward rank (mean compute + mean communication to exit)
orders.name: heft_upward

orders.formula: probe schedule(dag, stable_topo, fixed_actions); Kahn priority = descending observed finish
orders.label: canonical scheduler-aware rank (observed probe completion time)
orders.name: canonical_aware
